items.title: Java Developer — Mindgate Solutions
items.intro: Java developer building tax-payment products and internal banking tools at Mindgate Solutions.
items.details:
Backend development for banking and regulatory payment integrations.
- Built tax-payment portal services for a multinational banking client across multiple Nigerian payment channels.
- Created an internal cryptographic digital-signature generator for a regulatory API integration in the Middle East.
- Built migration tools and supporting internal utilities used by the engineering team.
- Developed microservices with Java, Spring Boot, WebSphere, Kafka, Oracle Database, and PostgreSQL.
items.note: Work includes tax-payment integrations, regulator API signing, platform migration tooling, and production support.

- Uses Blink.cmp, Telescope, FZF-Lua, Fugitive, Diffview, Gitsigns, Harpoon2, and Lualine.
- Includes theme choices and documented keybindings for navigation and diagnostics.
